brief: Slovak media coverage of banking/payments regulation is concentrated in a small set of national business desks (Index SME, HNonline/Finweb, TREND, Pravda Ekonomika, Denník N) plus one genuine sector trade outlet, FinReport.sk, with EURACTIV.sk serving as the key bridge between EU financial-services files and Slovak transposition. Wire agencies TASR (teraz.sk) and SITA, and the oPeniazoch.sk aggregator, provide the earliest timestamps and durable, free archives of items that later disappear or move behind paywalls, making them the practical backbone of continuous monitoring. Legal trade media (EPRAVO.SK, Právne Noviny) and the EPI.sk Zbierka zákonov index convert media mentions into precise legal instruments and effective dates, while INESS supplies the analytical framing that mainstream coverage of the bank levy reuses. The main weaknesses are paywalls on the highest-value outlets and the absence of systematic journalistic reporting of NBS enforcement actions, which must be compensated with official registers and per-entity searches.
